label: Tree Bark

provenance.incarnation: OriginalPS2 MGS3 1964 NakedSnake, before-eye-injury two naturaleyes, nofacepaint, Mk22+CQCknife. No MGSV/Delta/otherage import.

sources.scope: Original-renderer MGS3 NO PAINT/TREE BARK selected menu, real body material and enlarged swatch. Exact hardware PS2/HD edition not established, original model family rather than Delta. Root accepted improved large irregular vertical olivegray/burgundy ribbons as closest recreation; bands still too continuous versus actual retail islands, no pixel-exact tile certificate.
Existing approved originalPS2 preinjury wholebody reference and nativebase supplies anatomical/gear geometry; chosen newcamo material comes from per-pattern source above.
